title: EconomicEvent
description: Placeholder event for typed, auditable game-only currency deltas. Economic events must be reconciled through the continuity ledger and do not implement real-money exchange, monetization, pricing, or external value.

asset_id.description: Game-only currency asset to mutate through EconomyLedger.mutate().

amount.description: Signed in-game quantity delta. This is not external value data.

reason.description: Implementation-defined gameplay reason for the delta.

change_id.description: Idempotency key used by the ledger mutation path.

timestamp.description: Producer timestamp in epoch milliseconds for audit correlation.
